shortDescription: Manages administrator objects on Checkpoint over Web Services API

options.name: authentication_method
options.description: Authentication method.

options.name: auto_publish_session
options.description: Publish the current session if changes have been performed after task completes.

options.name: color
options.description: Color of the object. Should be one of existing colors.

options.name: comments
options.description: Comments string.

options.name: details_level
options.description: The level of detail for some of the fields in the response can vary from showing only the UID value of the object to a fully detailed representation of the object.

options.name: email
options.description: Administrator email.

options.name: expiration_date
options.description: Format, YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-mm-ddThh,mm,ss.

options.name: ignore_errors
options.description: Apply changes ignoring errors. You won't be able to publish such a changes. If ignore-warnings flag was omitted - warnings will also be ignored.

options.name: ignore_warnings
options.description: Apply changes ignoring warnings.

options.name: multi_domain_profile
options.description: Administrator multi-domain profile.

options.name: must_change_password
options.description: True if administrator must change password on the next login.

options.name: name
options.description: Object name.

options.name: password
options.description: Administrator password.

options.name: password_hash
options.description: Administrator password hash.

options.name: permissions_profile
options.description: Permission profile

options.name: permissions_profile_list
options.description: Administrator permissions profile. Permissions profile should not be provided when multi-domain-profile is set to "Multi-Domain Super User" or "Domain Super User". Used only in MDS.

options.name: phone_number
options.description: Administrator phone number.

options.name: radius_server
options.description: RADIUS server object identified by the name or UID. Must be set when "authentication-method" was selected to be "RADIUS".

options.name: state
options.description: State of the access rule (present or absent).

options.name: tacacs_server
options.description: TACACS server object identified by the name or UID. Must be set when "authentication-method" was selected to be "TACACS".

options.name: tags
options.description: Collection of tag identifiers.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of checkpoint. If not given one, the latest version taken.

options.name: wait_for_task
options.description: Wait for the task to end. Such as publish task.

options.name: wait_for_task_timeout
options.description: How many minutes to wait until throwing a timeout error.
